highlights: Banana Jelly|Tropic Eclipse|Kosher Kush|Exotic Fruit Hybrids

name: Grass-o-Matic
audit_note:
Grass-o-Matic, based in Valencia, Spain, was established in 2007 as one of the world's first seed banks to specialize 100% in high-quality autoflowering feminized seeds. They worked closely with the legendary breeder Stitch to develop compact, high-yielding hybrids that do not rely on light cycles. Their most famous collaboration, Med Gom 1.0, was developed with the CBD Crew and stands as one of the first high-CBD autoflowers ever brought to market. Their philosophy is "simplicity and quality," providing reliable genetics for home growers and medical patients who need fast, consistent harvests.

Grass-o-Matic does not operate an active, direct-to-consumer website. To purchase their genetics, you must use authorized international seed banks and distributors that carry their classic autoflowering strains (such as Maxi GOM and Auto AK).
highlights: Automatic Ak47|Maxi Gom|Sugar Gom|Med Gom 1.0|Auto Mass|Haze Gom|Jacky Cbd

name: Great Lakes Genetics
audit_note: Great Lakes Genetics is a top-tier Michigan-based seed bank that has built a stellar reputation over the last decade for its "Generosity with Freebies" and deep catalog of artisanal breeders. They are a primary retail node for some of the industry's most respected names, including Bodhi Seeds, DJ Short, Strayfox Gardenz, and Tonygreen's Tortured Beans. They are particularly noted for their "Bad Dawg" freebie line and their consistent support of the medical grower community, offering a vast array of Regular (non-feminized) seeds alongside modern feminized and autoflower hybrids.
highlights: Bodhi Seeds specialist|Old-school preservation lines|High-rarity drops

name: Green Bodhi
audit_note: Green Bodhi, founded by John Bayes in Eugene, Oregon, is a pioneer in organic cannabis cultivation. Their method, "Intentional Horticulture," combines high-level organic practices with Buddhist mindfulness, aiming to benefit both the plant and the consumer's well-being. They are famous for their Hazy 8 and '89 Northern Lights 5 Bx work, specializing in lineages that prioritize high terpene content and "spiritually significant" effects. They were the nation's first licensed indoor facility to receive Envirocann third-party organic certification.
highlights: Hazy Kush|Tenzin Kush|89 Northern Lights 5 Bx|Sour Best Shit EverTwist|Skywalker 78

name: Green Fire Genetics
audit_note: Green Fire Genetics is a distinguished Northern California breeder led by Alaina Austin. As a third-generation grower, Alaina carries forward a deep familial legacy, blending traditional organic cultivation with modern breeding innovation. The brand is celebrated for its "Flavor-Forward" philosophy, prioritizing complex terpene profiles and balanced THC:CBD ratios. Their signature strain, Green Fire OG (Green Crack x Fire OG), is a multi-award winner noted for its refreshing citrus-diesel aroma and potent, balanced effects. They operate a 360-acre farm in Mendocino, focusing on stable, high-yielding hybrids that reflect the unique "terroir" of the Emerald Triangle.
highlights: Green Fire Og

name: Green House Seed Co
audit_note: Green House Seed Co. is a legendary Amsterdam-based seed bank and the most decorated cannabis business in history. Founded by Arjan Roskam, the "King of Cannabis," they are famous for stabilizing some of the world's most iconic genetics, including White Widow, Super Silver Haze, and Super Lemon Haze. Their "Strain Hunters" mission involves traveling the globe to find and preserve rare landrace genetics. They offer a massive inventory of feminized and autoflowering seeds and maintain a high-authority presence through their Amsterdam coffeeshops and international distribution network.
highlights: Super Lemon Haze|White Widow|Jack Herer|Super Silver Haze|Exodus Cheese|Lemon Skunk|Arjans Ultra Haze|Kalashnikova|The Church|Himalaya Gold|Bubba Kush|Chemdog

name: Green Mountain Cannabis Works
audit_note: A locally-run dispensary in Manchester, VT. They are a confirmed seed-selling node, carrying a variety of seeds from Vermont-based craft cultivators. Perfect for your map as a physical "Verified Seed Retailer."

name: Green Mountain Seeds
audit_note:
Led by the veteran breeder "Vermontman," they specialize in ultra-fast, northern-climate adapted Sativas. They are most famous for Green Mountain Grape and Mountain Gold. They operate as a breeding house and distribute primarily through Ace Seeds and North Atlantic Seed Co.

Green Mountain Seeds does not operate a standalone retail website; instead, their genetics are exclusively distributed and sold through authorized online seed banks.

name: Green Team Genetics
audit_note: Green Team Genetics is a premier Massachusetts-based craft seed company founded in 2008. They are highly regarded for their "quality over quantity" ethos, using strictly organic methods for seed production. Their breeding program is centered on creating stable, high-performing regulars with bold terpene expressions, particularly in their "Fruit" and "Pie" lines. Each pack of seeds is individually numbered and produced in very limited quantities, making them a "collector's" brand for pheno-hunters. To purchase their premium seeds, you can order directly through authorized seed banks.
highlights: Fruit Pie|Chembustion|Orange Fruit Bound|Lemon Fruit Bound

name: Green Tree Medicinals - Berthoud
audit_note: Green Tree Medicinals is an all-natural cannabis producer that has been cultivating and dispensing in Colorado since 2009. Their Berthoud location serves both medical patients and recreational customers (21+). They are a confirmed seed-selling node, carrying a rotating selection of local Colorado genetics. Unlike many retail-heavy dispensaries, they maintain a specific "Seeds" category on their menu, making them a reliable destination for home growers in the Front Range area.
highlights: Freeworld Genetics (Seeds)|High Mountain Imports (Seeds)|flower|concentrates|edibles|vapes|pre-rolls

name: Greenhouse Strain Hunters
audit_note: Greenhouse Strain Hunters is a high-authority division of the Green House Seed Co. founded in 2008. Dedicated to the late Franco Loja, the brand is world-famous for its "Strain Hunters" documentaries, where the team travels to remote regions (Congo, Morocco, Colombia) to find and preserve landrace genetics. Their seed catalog focuses on taking these rare genetics and crossing them into stable, high-yielding feminized hybrids. Their flagship coffeeshop on the Singel canal serves as a cultural hub for the brand in Amsterdam.
highlights: Money Maker

name: GreenLabel Seeds
audit_note: GreenLabel Seeds is an Amsterdam-based seed company that operates on the belief that cannabis is a "gift from nature" with long-underestimated medicinal value. They focus on refining and stabilizing popular genetics to ensure high germination rates and reliable growth for both medical and recreational hobbyists. Their catalog is particularly strong in high-Sativa hybrids and reliable autoflowers. They are known for providing exceptional value, often producing results that rival more expensive "boutique" banks while maintaining a lower price point.
highlights: Amnesia

name: Greenshock Farms
audit_note: NA
highlights: NA

name: Greenway Solutions Seeds
audit_note: Greenway Solutions is a craft-focused breeder from New Jersey led by "Andy." The brand started as a passion project for reversing and preserving "lost" old-school genetics. They are known for providing high-value seeds (averaging $25–$50 per pack) that have been rigorously tested in both indoor and outdoor environments across multiple locations. Their catalog is diverse, featuring crosses like Hash Gordon and Cherry Toke, and they are a staple on high-authority seed banks like Genetic Supply and Dagga Garden.
highlights: Hash Gordon

name: GreyBeard Seeds
audit_note: GreyBeard Seeds is a veteran-led operation that functions as both a high-volume seed bank and a breeding house. They specialize in Autoflowers, claiming to be the pioneers of the category for public sale. Their catalog is massive, featuring thousands of strains from top-tier international breeders alongside their Greybeard Private Label. They focus on high-potency and resilient genetics, catering to both hobbyists and experienced breeders with a deep inventory of regular, feminized, and autoflower seeds.
highlights: Greybeard Private Label (60+)

name: GritNasty Seeds
audit_note:
GritNasty Seeds is a niche breeder that has gained traction for stabilizing some of the most sought-after "heavy" genetics on the market. They are particularly noted for their work with Kali Mist and Motorbreath crosses. Their philosophy centers on industrial-strength potency and "loud" terpene profiles, often leaning into the garlic, fuel, and chem aromas. They distribute through high-authority boutique banks, ensuring that their limited-run drops reach serious pheno-hunters and collectors.

There is no standalone direct-to-consumer website for GritNasty Seeds. Their craft cannabis genetics and seed packs are primarily distributed through authorized online seed banks.
highlights: Kali Mist F3

name: Grounded Genetics
audit_note: Grounded Genetics is a Barcelona-based powerhouse that emerged from the legacy market to become a global leader in high-end hybrids. They are famous for their Bacio, Runtz, and Z Road lines, which focus on translating complex "candy-gas" profiles into stable seed form. Their operations address at Headstash BCN serves as a core node for their breeding projects. They are particularly noted for their transparency regarding lineage and their ability to consistently secure elite, verified cuts for their breeding projects.
highlights: Zilk Road

name: Grow More Fire Genetics
audit_note: Grow More Fire Genetics is a Nevada-based breeder specializing in "True Exotic" photoperiod and feminized seeds. They are particularly famous for their Super Buff Cherry and Sub Zero selections, often focusing on heavy resin production and complex "candy-gas" terpene profiles. Their marketing revolves around the "Grow More Stress Less" philosophy, and they frequently release limited-edition collection boxes (like the Blueberry Series or Kut Throat Kollection) that target serious pheno-hunters.
highlights: Super Buff Cherry S1

name: Growbarato Seeds
audit_note: Large-scale grow shop and retail franchise. Maintains "GB Strains" as a house-brand/white-label collection but primarily functions as a distributor for other seed companies.
highlights: NA

name: Growers Choice Seeds
audit_note: Growers Choice Seeds is a premier international seed bank and breeding house with nearly a decade of market presence. Based in Eureka, California, with deep roots in the Dutch breeding tradition, they focus on genetic consistency and accessibility for home growers. They are famous for their Critical Purple Auto and White Fire OG (WiFi OG) genetics, which are noted for extreme THC levels (up to 30%). Their operation is characterized by rigorous hand-selection of seeds and a comprehensive educational platform that supports both novice and expert cultivators.
highlights: Tangerine Dream Auto|Critical Purple Auto|White Widow|OG Kush|High-vigor autoflowers

name: GTR
audit_note:
This is the direct-to-consumer recreational seed brand launched by Oregon CBD, which is hands-down one of the most scientifically advanced, highly decorated, and large-scale cannabis genomics breeding companies in the United States.

The Backstory: Founded in 2015 by brothers Seth and Eric Crawford in Southern Oregon, the team built a global reputation operating under industrial hemp licenses. They spent years accumulating massive data sets, executing comprehensive genomic sequencing, and pioneering industry firsts in minor cannabinoid stabilization (including pure CBG, CBDV, and THCV lines).

The GTR Transition: While they originally supplied massive multi-acre commercial agricultural farms, the 2022 DEA clarification regarding cannabis seeds allowed them to open their elite library directly to home growers. They rebranded their public-facing retail storefront to GTR Seeds (Grow the Revolution).
highlights: They are global pioneers in Triploid cannabis seeds.

name: GuamMaineian Gardens
audit_note: Small-batch craft breeder known for unique hybrid crosses. Frequently discussed in community forums (e.g., Overgrow) for their specialized genetic work.

name: H.B.K Genetics
audit_note:
H.B.K. Genetics (Half Baked Kids) is led by Eric Minor, a second-generation farmer and multi-cup winning topical maker with over 30 years of experience. Originally from Hawaii and now based in California, Eric focuses on landrace-influenced lines with bold citrus and fuel terpenes. He is most famous for creating the flagship Green Ribbon (originally Green Kandy Crack) and Chile Verde OG. His breeding philosophy is deeply rooted in compassion and the healing properties of CBD, making his seeds a top choice for medicinal-focused cultivators and connoisseurs seeking stable, high-terpene regular seeds.

HBK (H.B.K. Genetics) seeds are primarily sold through established distributor websites and specialized seed banks rather than a standalone direct-to-consumer site.
highlights: Green Ribbon

name: H.O.N. Genetics
audit_note: H.O.N. Genetics (Healing of the Nations) does not operate an independent direct-to-consumer website. Instead, you can find authentic H.O.N. Genetics seeds stocked through authorized online distributors.

name: Hammerhead Genetics
audit_note:
Hammerhead Genetics is led by a veteran breeder with nearly half a century of personal cultivation history. Known for a passion for preserving "lost" varieties from the 70s and 80s, the brand is highly respected for its technical skill—the founder notably grew the 2012 High Times Cup-winning Gorilla Glue. Their catalog is extensive, featuring over 23 stabilized strains that often lean into long-flowering Sativas and complex polyhybrids. They are a staple on Great Lakes Genetics, where their seeds are typically priced at a premium ($100 per pack) for serious collectors.

Hammerhead Genetics does not operate a direct-to-consumer website. You can purchase their seeds exclusively through authorized, trusted seed banks.
highlights: Pink Banana Crush

name: Happy Dreams Genetics
audit_note: Happy Dreams Genetics is an award-winning, sustainable legacy breeder rooted in Humboldt County, California. Founded by Mr. D, they are the original creators of the famous Vanilla Frosting, The Bling, and Apple Custard. Their breeding philosophy combines traditional organic methods with a drive for unique, exotic terpene profiles ranging from creamy dessert notes to sharp lime and fuel. They are highly respected for producing stable, high-THC genetics that perform exceptionally well in both indoor and outdoor environments.
highlights: Vanilla Frosting

name: Happy Valley Genetics
audit_note: Happy Valley Genetics is a premier Massachusetts-based breeder and dispensary operator. "Powered by Ethos," they specialize in the meticulous stabilization of elite genetics, offering home growers the same award-winning quality found in their commercial harvests. They are famous for their Super Lemon Haze and White Wedding phenotypes, which have secured multiple High Times Cannabis Cups. Their Gloucester facility is a true "seed-to-sale" operation, featuring one of the state's most diverse seed menus including both boutique autoflowers and heavy-hitting photoperiods.
highlights: Another Level|Super Lemon Haze|White Wedding|Lemon Smuggler

name: Harry Haze Seeds
audit_note: Harry Haze Seeds is a boutique cannabis breeder celebrated for creating heavy-hitting hybrids with bold, pungent aromas. They specialize in working with elite lineages such as MAC, Headbanger, Wookie, and various OG Kush cuts. Their breeding focus is on high THC content, thick resin production, and "loud" flavor profiles that blend fuel, menthol, and sweet candy notes. They are particularly popular among connoisseurs and hash makers due to the resin quality of their regular seed lines.
highlights: Wookiez

name: Haute Genetique
audit_note: Haute Genetique is a high-level US boutique breeder based in California. They are best known for the "Raspberry Collection," which utilizes a legendary Northern California male known as "WOW" (Pink Champagne). This specific male is a stabilized cross of a rare clone and Strawberry Diesel, celebrated for its raspberry aroma and intense purple coloring. Their work, such as XO Raspberry Glue and Raspberry Cookies, is designed for connoisseurs seeking rare, aromatic profiles and high resin production. While the famous Raspberry Boogie is often associated with this profile, it is actually a Mosca Seeds production, though Haute Genetique's Raspberry Cookies is their primary equivalent in the boutique space.
highlights: XO Raspberry Glue

name: Hawaiian Budline
audit_note: Hawaiian Budline is a renowned breeder operating in the unique microclimates of Hilo, Hawaii. Their "Hawaiianized" signature refers to a rigorous selection process where seeds are put through 70%+ humidity and 30-degree temperature shifts to ensure they can thrive in any standard environment. They are most famous for strains like Jah-Waiian, Vanilla Shave Ice, and Blueberry Jiu Jitsu. Their work often features complex lineage including elite cuts like Lemon Alien Dawg and Tahoe Alien, blended with local island genetics to produce plants that are both aesthetically striking and highly resilient.
highlights: Jah-Waiian|Vanilla Shave Ice|Blueberry Jiu Jitsu|Mac-Nut Barz|Kalika Butter|Kimo Slice|Hawaiian Jealousy

name: Hawaiian Heirloom Genetics
audit_note: Hawaiian Heirloom Genetics is an island-based breeding house focused on the preservation and refinement of iconic Hawaiian cultivars. They are particularly famous for their work with Skunkdog, Maui lines, and 98 Widow. Their breeding objective is to create sturdy plants with "loud" terpene profiles (skunk, citrus, and berry) that can withstand the high humidity often found in tropical climates. Their catalog features unique crosses like Skunk Hash Chem and Maui Cakes, catering to growers who value authentic island terpene profiles and mold-resistant flower structures.
highlights: Skunk Hash Chem

name: Hazeman Seeds
audit_note: Hazeman Seeds is a legendary breeding house led by "Hazeman," who grew for other major breeders for years before launching his own label in the early 2000s. The brand is a purist's favorite, specializing in old-school, primarily Indica strains and avoiding feminized seeds entirely to maintain genetic integrity. They are credited with keeping the '88 G-13 Hashplant line alive and unchanged for decades. Despite being "so old school they don't have a direct website," they are a cornerstone of the global seed trade, supplying dozens of international banks with high-stability genetics.
highlights: 88 G-13 Hashplant

name: Headie Gardens
audit_note: Headie Gardens is a boutique US seed bank widely considered one of the most reliable sources for authentic heritage and modern "fire" genetics. Led by the industry veteran "Shoe," the bank is known for its incredible freebie program and exclusive access to the full Bodhi Seeds library. The site often requires a password (historically muffcabbage or headie) to view the menu, a tactic used to manage high demand and maintain a "vetted" customer base. They are noted for fast shipping and a high level of personal customer service within the Overgrow and Reddit communities.
highlights: Curated artisan breeding|Exclusive "drop" culture|Exceptional customer transparency

name: Heads Research
audit_note: Heads Research is a California-based breeding collective known for its "Research & Development" philosophy. They prioritize chemical analysis and phenotype stabilization, resulting in strains that consistently test high for both THC and complex secondary terpenes. Their flagship work, such as Brumale and Zanshin, often utilizes elite parents like Oishii and Trippin Dots. They are highly regarded for their Tanghulu and Whippetz autoflowers, which provide commercial-grade quality in an accessible, fast-flowering format.
highlights: Brumale

name: Healing Path Gentetics
audit_note: Healing Path Genetics is a specialized breeding group that prioritizes medicinal efficacy and genetic accessibility. They are unique for their focus on Regular seeds in an increasingly feminized market, encouraging home-breeding and preservation. Their flagship "Assault" line (e.g., Orange Assault) is noted for its high-vigor photoperiod performance, while their CBD Yeti Autofem targets medical users seeking low-THC, high-CBD options with the ease of an autoflower cycle.
highlights: Orange Assault

name: Heart & Soil CBD
audit_note: The Heart & Soil Project is a Denver-based collective of breeders and distributors committed to sustainable hemp cultivation. They specialize in high-CBD genetics and have successfully bridged the gap between industrial hemp and craft cannabis. Their work is often featured in "connoisseur" CBD catalogs, and they are recognized for their commitment to biodiversity and grassroots community involvement. They are notably distinct from the "Heart & Soil" supplement company—this entity is strictly focused on cannabis/hemp genetics and cultivation services.
highlights: Virgin Valley|CBD Rich Strains|Hemp Apparel|Cultivation Advisory Services

name: Heartrock Mountain Farm
audit_note: Heartrock Mountain Farm is a 120-acre off-grid family operation led by Clifford and Daniel Morford. Perched at 2500ft elevation, they specialize in "clean green" intentional medicine. Their in-house brand, Pride of the Lion, features genetics dating back to 1976. They are major award-winners, notably taking Gold for Love and Laughter (a high-CBDa strain) at the California State Fair. Their breeding focus spans across exotic "hash-makers," stable heirlooms like Blue Thunder, and pioneering high-minor-cannabinoid landraces (CBD/THCV).
highlights: Love and Laughter (High CBD)

name: Heavy Trichome Genetics
audit_note: Heavy Trichome Genetics is an artisan breeding label hailing from the rugged climate of Michigan's Upper Peninsula. As their name suggests, their selection process focuses almost exclusively on "frost" coverage and resin quality. They are best known for Rankenstein (a pungent, heavy-hitting hybrid) and Sugar Muff, which are favored by boutique growers looking for high bag appeal and "sugar-dusted" flowers. Their use of "Regular" seeds reflects a commitment to old-school genetic stability and breeding potential.
highlights: Rankenstein

name: Heavyweight Seeds
audit_note: Heavyweight Seeds is a Spanish-born breeding house that has grown into a global distribution node. They are famous for their "Monster" genetics—strains specifically stabilized to produce larger-than-average crops with high THC levels (often 20% or higher). Their catalog is a mix of "Old School" genetics (Skunk, Afghani, Northern Lights) and modern, high-flavor hybrids. They are particularly recognized for their Fast & Vast and 2 Fast 2 Vast autoflowers, which set industry standards for yield in the auto-flowering category.
highlights: Fruit Punch

name: Heirloom Organics
audit_note: Heirloom Organics is a family-owned brand under the Skaneateles Seed Co. umbrella. They are recognized for their focus on "boutique-quality" genetics, producing seeds in limited runs to maintain high quality control. Their catalog often features hybrids with distinctive, often humorous names like Spy Balloon and Mom's Spaghetti, alongside more regional-focused lines like FLX Flowers (referencing the Finger Lakes region of New York). Their mission is to provide home growers with accessible, stable, and unique genetic profiles that aren't found in mass-market catalogs.
highlights: FLX Flowers

name: Heisen Beans
audit_note: Heisenbeans Genetics is led by a breeder known for extreme stability and "built different" business practices. Heisen operates Seedlys, a platform that uses a unique reverse-auction system where prices drop every 15 minutes until a reserve is met. His breeding focuses on elite modern hybrids like Gucciberry, Drip-N-Stix, and Apple Stomper. He is highly regarded for his transparency regarding seed counts and his technical integration of AI and SEO into the cannabis space, making his data some of the most accessible for digital mapping projects.
highlights: Gucciberry

name: Hella Seed Co
audit_note: Hella Seed Co is a specialized California breeder that has gained a cult following for their extensive work with the GAK (G13 x AK47) mother plant. Their breeding philosophy revolves around extreme aroma profiles and resin stability, often crossing the GAK line with elite parents like Dosidos and Slurricane. Note that while they share a similar name, they are distinct from Humboldt Seed Company, which produces the famous Hella Jelly strain. Hella Seed Co is a separate boutique entity focused on "Regular" seeds for the enthusiast market.
highlights: Mack's GAK

name: Helvetic Seeds
audit_note: Swiss-based heritage breeder focused on the preservation of traditional Swiss genetics (e.g., Erdbeer, Purpurea 09) and the creation of stable, outdoor-suitable hybrid lines.

name: Her Seed Bank
audit_note: Her Seed Bank is a mission-driven Buffalo small business that positions cannabis cultivation as an act of resistance and self-sufficiency. They curate genetics from reputable breeders (like Ethos, Mephisto, and Dirty Bird) while also providing educational consults for home growers. Their platform is unique for its vocal support of reproductive rights, LGBTQ+ rights, and restorative justice within the cannabis industry. They are a primary node for the New York cannabis community, offering everything from classic heirlooms to high-THC modern hybrids.
highlights: Grandmommy Purple|Godzilla Cookies Auto

name: Herb and Market
audit_note: Herb & Market is a standout retail node in Arcata that bridges the gap between traditional dispensaries and boutique wellness markets. They focus on "real" California cannabis, specifically supporting small-scale, regenerative farmers. The shop is highly active in community mutual aid, hosting free supply stands and advocating for a sustainable organic cannabis economy. Their seed menu is primarily powered by Humboldt Seed Company, featuring high-stabilization lines like All Gas OG, Blueberry Cupcake, and Hella Jelly.
highlights: Humboldt Seed Company (Various)|Terroir-Focused Flower|Small-Batch Hash|Pure Tinctures|Artisan Edibles

name: Herbies Seeds
audit_note: Herbies Seeds is a dominant international node in the cannabis genetic market. They are widely recognized for their "Stealth Shipping" methods and 24/7 customer support. Their house brand, Herbies Seeds, features high-THC bestsellers like Grandmommy Purple (up to 33% THC) and Godzilla Cookies Auto. They serve as a primary retail hub for nearly all major European and American breeders, providing a unified platform for price comparison and bulk ordering.
highlights: Grandmommy Purple|Godzilla Cookies Auto

name: Heritage Seed Bank
audit_note: Heritage Seed Bank is a staple in the US genetic market, led by long-time growers who prioritize "homework-verified" authenticity. They are a primary retail node for high-demand breeders, often getting exclusive drops of rare landrace hybrids and cutting-edge cultivars. They are particularly noted for carrying a deep inventory of Top Dawg Seeds and CSI:Humboldt, making them a destination for serious collectors seeking stabilized heritage lines.
highlights: Legacy and heirloom preservation|Rare landrace genetics|Academic-level strain documentation

name: Hermetic Genetics
audit_note: Hermetic Genetics is a boutique Oregon breeder that prioritizes genetic diversity and soil health through regenerative farming. Their work involves meticulously preserving classic lines such as Durban Poison, Nepalese Kush, and DJ Short's Blueberry. They are unique for their "open-pollination" techniques and filial generations (F1, F2, etc.) designed to maintain regional adaptability and broad gene pools. Their strains, such as Peach Wreck and Siskiyou Sasquatch, are testaments to their "art meets science" philosophy, often hitting 18–22% THC with heavy focus on specific terpene expression.
highlights: Peach Wreck

name: Hero Seeds
audit_note: Dutch breeder established in 2002; known for a "superhero" theme across their product line and a focus on durable, feminized, and mold-resistant genetics.

name: Heroes of the Farm
audit_note: Heroes of the Farm is a Tier II producer and breeder that transitioned from Portland's medical closet-grow scene to a million-dollar professional facility near Mt. Hood. Led by Patrick Pooler, they prioritize "purpose-driven" strain development, focusing on balanced effects and strong terpene identities rather than just raw THC. Their genetics are frequently used as the foundation for other Oregon brands and are a staple on Leafly's top-rated lists.
highlights: Orange Glue|Marionberry Kush|Gorilla Snacks|Mad Max|Interspecies Erotica|Angry Wizard

name: Herring Chokers
audit_note: US-based micro-breeder established ~2014. Known for small-batch regular and feminized seed releases. Distributed through boutique seed retailers.

name: High Alpine Genetics
audit_note: High Alpine Genetics is a premier name in the therapeutic hemp world. Thomas Swanson has gained global acclaim for his commitment to organic, mountain-grown genetics that prioritize rich terpene and cannabinoid profiles while strictly adhering to legal THC limits (<0.3%). They are noted for their collaboration with Flow Gardens and their "Monster Mash" combo packs, which offer bulk high-CBD seeds to commercial and hobbyist growers. Their flagship strain, Alpen Gleaux, has been featured in High Times and is prized for its vibrant purple hues and high resin content.
highlights: Payton's Lemons Line

name: High Lonesome Grass Seed
audit_note: High Lonesome Genetics is led by a breeder dedicated to "plants with unique character, flavors and highs" rather than commercial uniformity. Their most significant contribution to the cannabis gene pool is the Appalachia line (Green Crack x Tres Dawg), which has been used as a cornerstone parent by other elite breeders like Bodhi Seeds. Their current work, such as the Chemdog D BX and Mango Haze hybrids, is prized by connoisseurs for its complexity, potency, and "stony" euphoric effects.
highlights: Appalachia f3

name: High Power Genetics
audit_note: High Power Genetics is an artisan Michigan breeder that focuses on maximizing the "power" of the plant—meaning both its physiological vigor and its psychoactive potency. They are best known for the Power Line and their High Voltage crosses. Their breeding philosophy emphasizes large, dense floral structures and heavy trichome coverage, making their genetics popular for both flower production and extraction. They are highly active in the Michigan caregiver community and are frequent participants in regional genetics swaps and cups.
highlights: High Voltage

name: High Speed Buds
audit_note: High Speed Buds has carved a specific niche by prioritizing speed and efficiency for commercial and outdoor growers. By crossing elite American "clones-only" (like Wedding Crasher or Purple Punch) with specialized fast-flowering ruderalis or early-finishing photoperiods, they produce plants that finish before early autumn rains. They are a high-volume node, often featuring high germination rates and aggressive growth patterns. While they carry a wide variety of "Fast" versions, they also maintain a strong Autoflower catalog that is popular among European greenhouse growers.
highlights: High Voltage Fast

name: High Tree Gardens Seeds
audit_note: High Tree Gardens operates as a high-tier genetic nursery. They are unique for offering "snips" (unrooted cuttings), which allow experienced growers to save on cost while ensuring they start with verified mother-stock. Their catalog is highly dynamic, frequently rotating in award-winning "Cali" genetics alongside heavy-hitting New England favorites. They prioritize genetic health and vigor, ensuring that their starts are free from common pathogens like HLVd before distribution.
highlights: Modern Hybrid Clones|Old School Heritage Snips|Boutique Seeds

name: Highrule Genetics
audit_note: Highrule Genetics is a creative Nevada-based breeder that has gained a cult following for integrating popular culture motifs with high-end genetics. Their work often involves elite parental stock like Cap Junky, Zelda Runtz, and Gary Payton. They are a staple at boutiques like Empire Breeding Co and Great Lakes Genetics, where they are lauded for their genetic stability and vibrant terpene profiles. Strains like Triforce OG and Nevada Mints highlight their regional pride and technical skill in selecting for "shelf-appeal" and potency.
highlights: Cap Junky BX1

name: Hoku Seed Co.
legal_name: Hoku Seed Company / Clearwater Family Farms
audit_note: Hoku Seed Co. is one of the most transparent operations in the Pacific Northwest. They focus on filling "gaps" in the genetic library by breeding for resilience, local climate adaptation, and complex cannabinoid ratios. Their work with THCV and "Early" (Fast) photoperiods makes them a primary node for northern growers and medical patients. They are famous for their lean, no-frills business model, which allows them to offer high-end genetics at significantly lower prices than typical "hype" banks.

name: Holland's High
audit_note: Holland's High is more than a seed bank; it is a comprehensive "Smartshop" that serves as a primary European node for cannabis genetics, magic truffles, and cultivation accessories. They have collaborated with industry titans like Barney's Farm, Sensi Seeds, and Royal Queen Seeds to curate one of the most diverse inventories on the web. Their business model emphasizes accessibility, providing detailed growing guides and competitive pricing for both hobbyists and commercial cultivators.
highlights: Candy Kush Banana

name: Holy Smoke Seeds
audit_note: Established European breeder led by "Nick." Focuses on hybridizing landrace and stable indica lines. Widely recognized in the international market.

name: Homegrown Cannabis Co
audit_note: Homegrown Cannabis Co. has positioned itself as the "Gold Standard" for home-grower education and genetics. By merging a massive seed bank with a robust content platform (including the "Homegrown Forum" and "Grow Your Own with Kyle Kushman" podcast), they serve as a primary entry point for new cultivators. They are noted for their high-THC feminized mix packs and specialized "Type 3" (CBD) genetics. While they are a large-scale commercial entity, their commitment to social equity and restorative justice via partnerships with the Last Prisoner Project adds significant community value to their brand.
highlights: Kyle Kushman’s Strawberry Cough

name: Homegrown Fantaseeds
audit_note: Established Amsterdam-based breeder (est. 1996). Holder of historical Positronics genetics. Award-winning company known for classic Dutch cultivars. Do not confuse with "Homegrown Cannabis Co."

name: Homegrown Genetics
audit_note: Homegrown Germination (often associated with Homegrown Genetics) is a craft-focused breeder that prioritizes seed vigor and genetic stability. Unlike mass-market banks, they focus on smaller catalogs of "tried and true" genetics, such as their Heirloom Kush and Midwest Skunk variants. They are widely cited in home-grower forums for their high germination rates and robust seedling vigor. Their "Germination First" philosophy involves rigorous batch testing to ensure that even novice growers can achieve a high success rate.
highlights: Heirloom Kush

name: Homegrown Natural Wonders
audit_note: Highly respected Pacific Northwest family-run breeder specializing in high-potency, regular (non-feminized) photoperiod cannabis seeds. Famous for award-winning strains like Dr. Who and Quantum Kush.

name: Honest Genetics
audit_note: Honest Genetics specializes in high-THC hybrids that lean heavily into "dessert" terpene profiles like chocolate, orange, and sweet candy. They are widely recognized for their Cookie Jar-based lines, which serve as the backbone for many of their most popular releases. The breeder is noted for maintaining smaller, exclusive batch sizes and providing special "freebie" seeds with regular pack purchases. Their work with Chocolate Frosting #67 and Orange Whip F3 has established them as a key player in the "flavor-first" breeding movement.
highlights: Fruit Fraiche|Chocolate Frosted Oranges|Selena Gomez)|Nicky Minaj|Lady GaGa|Chocolate Frosted Sherbert

name: Honey Pot Genetics
audit_note: Honey Pot Genetics has gained a technical reputation for breeding "washers"—strains specifically selected for their high trichome-to-biomass ratio, making them a favorite for hash and rosin makers. Their flagship strain, Slurrazil (Slurricane x Brazil Amazonas), is a testament to their skill in crossing elite modern hybrids with resilient landrace-leaning gems to create high-THC, mold-resistant cultivars. They are not to be confused with The Honey Pot Company (feminine care) or Honey Pot Cannabis (an edibles brand).
highlights: Slurrazil (F1 Reg)

name: Honey Sticks Genetics
audit_note: Honey Sticks Genetics is a premium Maine-based operation that bridges the gap between traditional breeding and professional nursery services. They are distinguished by their focus on terpene-rich, high-washing cultivars, making their genetics a top choice for solventless hash producers. Their breeding philosophy emphasizes "clean" clones and a strong Integrated Pest Management (IPM) regimen. By purchasing their clones or seeds, growers often "cut out the lengthy vegetation process" thanks to the inherent vigor of their stable, indica-leaning hybrids.
highlights: Bananaconda (Snake Cake x Dual OG)

name: Hooligan Automatics
audit_note: Hooligan Automatics (often marketed under the Hooligan Selections banner) is a craft-focused breeder that prioritizes flower quality and extraction potential. They are unique in the autoflower space for selecting parents based on their "trichome neck" strength and resin quality, traits often ignored in mass-market autos. Their work frequently involves crossing modern staples like Papaya or Animal Cookies with stabilized autoflowering foundations to create "go-fast" weed that doesn't compromise on potency. They are a staple at high-end boutiques like Dagga Garden and The High End Seed Co.
highlights: Key Lime HP

name: HortiLab
audit_note: HortiLab is one of the most decorated breeders in the modern era, having won over 15 cups since their inception. Their flagship strain, StarBud, is a multiple-time High Times Cannabis Cup winner, prized for its extreme resin production and potent Indica effects. They are equally famous for Sour Power, a Sativa-dominant hybrid (StarBud x East Coast Sour Diesel) that has taken first place at three separate Cannabis Cups. Their breeding philosophy centers on "connoisseur-quality" flavors and stabilizing "clones-only" traits into reliable seed forms.
highlights: StarBud (Indica)|Sour Power (Sativa)|Sour Amnesia|Super Sour Skunk|StarBerry|Sour Pink Grapefruit

name: House Of The Great Gardener
legal_name: House of the Great Gardener, S.L.
audit_note: House of the Great Gardener is a primary node for medicinal genetics. Their most famous creation, Barbara Bud (Shishkaberry x Afghani), is a "superstar" strain known for having double the resin production of standard cultivars, making it a world-class choice for hash and rosin. They were pioneers in the CBD movement, with CBD René winning the first-ever 1st place for CBD Flower at the 2014 High Times Cannabis Cup. Their work focuses on stability and ensuring that patients have access to the exact phenotypes they rely on for relief.
highlights: Barbara Bud (Fem/Reg)

name: Huckleberry Genetics
audit_note: Huckleberry Genetics has carved out a niche by focusing on "flavor-forward" genetics that lean heavily into tropical fruit, grape, and sweet fuel profiles. They are noted for their "Express" series—lines designed for speed and vigor, often using their Stomper Express or Apple Express pollen donors. They are a staple at high-end U.S. seed banks, where they are praised for providing large seed counts (often 12-pack regulars) at competitive prices. They should not be confused with Huckleberry Hill Farms (a legacy Humboldt farm) or the Oregon Huckleberry lines from Dynasty Seeds.
highlights: Tiger Beltz (Apples & Bananas x Rainbow Belts 2.0)

name: Huckleberry Hill Farms
audit_note: Huckleberry Hill Farms is a cultural landmark in the Emerald Triangle. John Casali, who spent 17 years in the federal system during the War on Drugs, returned to his family land to preserve his mother's 45-year-old heirloom genetics. Their flagship strain, Whitethorn Rose (Paradise Punch x Lemon OG), is legendary in the extraction community, having won over 10 Emerald Cup awards for its unique lavender and citrus terpene profile and exceptional "wash" quality. The farm utilizes regenerative practices, including rainwater catchment and solar power.
highlights: Whitethorn Rose

name: Humboldt CSI
audit_note: CSI Humboldt is defined by a "No Hype, Just Heat" philosophy. Nspecta is world-renowned for his "Fallen Soldiers" and "S1" projects, where he takes elite, clone-only staples (like Triangle Kush, Bubba Kush, and Chem D) and stabilizes them into seed form. His work is the primary source for many other breeders' foundational stock. As of 2026, he is the definitive authority on the Triangle Kush and T-1000 lineages.
highlights: Triangle Kush S1|T-1000|Bubba Kush Milled|Chem D S1|Mendo Purps S1|Old Family Purple|The Biz

name: Humboldt Seed Company
audit_note: Humboldt Seed Company is the preeminent node for stable, commercial-scale genetics. They are renowned for their technical approach to breeding, utilizing Leafworks certification to ensure 99%+ female ratios in their feminized lines. In 2026, they are leading the industry into the "Triploid Era"—genetics that offer higher potency and faster growth while being virtually sterile to prevent cross-pollination. Their partnership with the Yurok Agricultural Corporation highlights a commitment to social justice and tribal employment in Northern California.
highlights: Blueberry Muffin

name: Humboldt Seed Organization
audit_note: Humboldt Seed Organization (HSO) is a collective of breeders with over 25 years in the industry. While their genetic library is rooted in the Emerald Triangle, their modern operations are centralized in Europe to facilitate worldwide distribution. They are credited with being among the first to successfully stabilize Blue Dream and Amherst Sour Diesel for the commercial seed market. Their work focuses on "Californian elite" genetics, using science and technology to ensure high-yielding, high-potency varieties that maintain the quintessential "California smoke" profiles.
highlights: Blue Dream|OG Kush|Bubba Kush|Sour Diesel

name: Humminbird Hills
audit_note: Humminbird Hills is distinguished by a focus on "connoisseur" terpene profiles within the autoflower category—a space often criticized for lacking the flavor depth of photoperiods. Their flagship strain, Chicken Talk, is a technical standout, offering a polarizing and complex profile of durian funk, citric acid, and cherry menthol. They are noted for their high germination rates and the "fast-finishing" nature of their genetics, with most cultivars moving from sprout to harvest in 65–75 days. Their work is a staple for growers looking for extraction-ready resin in a compact, rapid-growth format.
highlights: Chicken Talk (Auto Fem)

name: Hybri-Tech
audit_note: Hybri-Tech has gained a technical reputation for creating high-performance hybrids that thrive in the Pacific Northwest climate. They are famous for The Big Dirty, a strain that gained cult status for its massive yields and intense, energizing citrus profile. Their work often bridges the gap between commercial viability and connoisseur quality, selecting for "washability" and rapid flowering times. They are closely associated with Pruf Cultivar, who helped bring several of their lines to the Oregon recreational market.
highlights: The Big Dirty (Tangie x Girl Scout Cookies)

name: Hyp3rids
audit_note:
Hyp3rids (often styled as Hyp3rids Strains) is a boutique cannabis breeder recognized for its focus on preserving and working with rare landrace, heirloom, and "Inbred" (IBL) lines from around the world.

Key Characteristics
Breeding Philosophy: Hyp3rids emphasizes "quality and effect" as their primary goals. They intentionally avoid the use of "breeder clones," preferring to work with their own selections from seed to ensure the full genetic spectrum of a variety is maintained.

Genetic Focus: Their collection is highly regarded by enthusiasts for its inclusion of difficult-to-find heirloom and landrace genetics, particularly from regions in Mexico, Thailand, and Hawaii. They often re-introduce these rare gene pools to the public as both re-worked lines and new hybrid crosses.
highlights: Kona Gold IBL|Purple Zacatecas|Puna Diesel IBL|Wolfman|Pacific Pearl

name: Hypno Seeds
audit_note: Hypno Seeds has reimagined the seed bank experience by integrating high-end genetics with a sophisticated digital environment. Their "Hypno World" feature allows growers to explore strains based on mood and effect profiles rather than just technical specs. They collaborate with breeders across the U.S., Asia, and Europe to develop lines like Red Chile Truffles and Juicy Pussy Auto. They are noted for their 100% Germination Guarantee and prioritize high-potency, "connoisseur" terpene profiles that cater to detail-oriented craft growers.
highlights: Red Chile Truffles|Blackberry Kush|Sticky Kitty Trippy Punch|Super Boof|Red Pistachio Auto|Cali Deli

name: I49
audit_note: I49 operates as a massive aggregate node in the U.S. market. Historically known for their collaboration with Blimburn Seeds, they have evolved into a portal that leverages the logistics of established giants like Seed Supreme and ILGM. This transition allows them to offer a "100% Germination Guarantee" backed by the industry's largest shipping infrastructures. They remain a primary research node for growers looking for specific crosses like Girl Scout Cookies x Jack Herer or Purple Star Killer.
highlights: White Widow|Bruce Banner Auto|Teatime|Grandaddy Bruce|Diverse global catalog

name: IBCeeds
audit_note: NA
highlights: NA

name: Iguana Smoke
audit_note: Iguana Smoke is a primary node for the European legal cannabis market. They distinguish themselves with organic cultivation practices and rigorous lab testing to ensure all products remain below the 0.2% THC threshold. Their flagship flowers, like Cherry Haze and Gorilla Glue CBD, are noted for maintaining "high-THC" terpene profiles without psychoactive effects. They are also pioneers in "New Molecules" like 10-OH and E8H, which they market through specialized vape and flower lines.
highlights: Cherry Haze CBD|Gorilla Glue CBD|Lemon Skunk|Triple Filtered Hash CBD

name: ILGM
audit_note: ILGM is a central hub for the cannabis community, supporting over a million growers since its inception. They distinguish themselves through the ILGM Grow Bible and an active community forum where experts provide real-time troubleshooting. Their breeding strategy focuses on stabilizing "Gold Standard" genetics like White Widow and Blue Dream to ensure high success rates for novice cultivators. In 2026, they continue to expand their "New Arrivals" line with modern hybrids like Gelato Sunrise and Golden Pineapple.
highlights: Gold Leaf|Bruce Banner|White Widow|Blueberry

name: Illusion Genetics
audit_note: Illusion Genetics is a niche breeder focused on the "connoisseur" market, often selecting for visual appeal (purple hues, heavy frost) and unique terpene profiles. Their work, such as Steel Grape and Blue Margarita, is designed for growers looking for "stand-out" bag appeal. They are frequently confused with Illusion F1 Corn or the Mind Games strain by Daze Off, but they are a distinct botanical breeding project focusing on high-THC cannabis.
highlights: Steel Grape

name: Imperial Extracts
audit_note: NA
highlights: NA

name: In House Genetics
audit_note: In House Genetics is a cornerstone of modern "exotic" cannabis culture. Their technical approach centers on creating "frozen" phenotypes—strains bred specifically for maximum resin coverage and bag appeal. Their most famous creation, Slurricane (Do-Si-Dos x Purple Punch), has become an industry standard for its berry-gas terpene profile and couch-lock potency. They are also credited with the Platinum line, which uses a specific "Platinum" pollen donor to add a distinct silver/frosty sheen and sturdy architecture to its crosses. Every drop is rigorously stress-tested to ensure repeatability for commercial facilities.
highlights: Slurricane #7 S1|Sugar Cane|Platinum Zushi|Jelly Breath S1|Black Cherry Punch|Platinum Gorilla

name: Indian Landrace Exchange
audit_note: Indian Landrace Exchange is not a traditional breeding company; it is a cultural and genetic preservation project. They specialize in documented, region-specific cultivars from locations like the Chitral Valley, Kandahar, and Balochistan. Their work is vital for safeguarding the original genetic foundations of cannabis, which are rapidly disappearing due to hybridization and modern agriculture. They maintain a "Silk Route to Salvation" model, where they document the specific nature and nurture of each strain, including climate, altitude, and traditional cultivation methods used by indigenous communities.
highlights: Kerala Gold|Balochistan Black Tiger|Nawa Elite Selections|Sheelawathi|Hindu Kush|Tosh Valley

name: Inkognyto Genetics
audit_note: Inkognyto Genetics is a technical powerhouse in the "heirloom-hybrid" space. They focus on medical efficacy, utilizing rare elites and "decades-old" varieties to ensure high-quality medicine at an accessible price. Their most significant contribution is the Pestilence donor (Abusive OG x West Coast Dog/OGers), which serves as the backbone for many of their most popular crosses. They are frequently found on Overgrow and THCFarmer, where they maintain transparency by sharing grow journals and testing data before commercial release.
highlights: Irukandji

name: Inspiration Seeds
audit_note: Inspiration Seeds has carved out a niche by utilizing elite parents like Glass Slipper and Chem Fuego. Their breeding philosophy prioritizes "visual drama"—selecting for deep purples, heavy trichome coverage, and unique bud structures. Strains like Moon Boots (Temple x Glass Slipper) and Swamp Gas (Maui Sour x Chem Fuego) are noted for their vigorous growth and "loud" aromatic presence. They are often associated with the same "artisan" breeding tier as nodes like Inkognyto Genetics and Illusion Genetics.
highlights: Moon Boots

name: Irie Genetics
audit_note: Irie Genetics is a central node for both genetics and cultivation education. Rasta Jeff has been breeding since the early 90s, focusing on plants that offer "limitless" head highs and therapeutic benefits. Their flagship Jack the Ripper F2 and Jack Tripper are benchmarks for lemon-candy profiles and cerebral intensity. Beyond seeds, their Grow From Your Heart Podcast serves as a vital educational resource, fostering a community of "Irie Army" growers who share testing data and cultivation tips.
highlights: Jack the Ripper F2

name: Izzy's Autos
audit_note: Izzy's Autos is a niche breeder known for high-performance autoflowers that rival photoperiods in terpene density. Their flagship Orange Star is a "sour orange flavor bomb" that leans heavily sativa (80%) and is noted for its ability to thrive in both indoor and solar-focused outdoor environments. They are categorized by the community as a "high-yield" breeder, with strains like Mini-Max Diesel and Iced Coffee Kush consistently producing large, frosty colas that are resistant to common environmental stressors.
highlights: Orange Star Auto Fem|Concord Crusher Auto Fem|Iced Coffee Kush Auto Fem|Lemon Treat Fem Auto

name: James Loud Genetics
audit_note: James Loud Genetics is a technical leader in genetic preservation and breeding science. James Loud's culinary background as a professional chef informs his "obsession" with terpene profiles and flavor complexity. The cornerstone of his operation is a rigorous tissue culture program used to "reset" genetics and eliminate pathogens. Beyond breeding, James is a prolific educator, authoring the reference book Cannabis Breeding: The Art and Science of Crafting Distinctive Cultivars and hosting the James Loud Podcast, which was named Podcast of the Year in 2024. His work focuses on providing accessible, clean genetics that are COA-verified for consistency and medical-grade quality.
highlights: Zuper Nova

name: Jane California
audit_note: Jane California has carved out a distinct identity by focusing on "flavor chasers" who prioritize tropical, fruit, and candy notes over traditional gassy profiles. Their work is characterized by compact plant structures and photogenic flowers that perform well in indoor, outdoor, and greenhouse environments. They are noted for their technical consistency in feminized seed production, ensuring high germination rates and stable phenotypic expressions. Their flagship strain, Tropical Marker, is a three-way cross of Permanent Marker, Lemon Cherry Gelato, and Strawnana, embodying their commitment to "elite-on-elite" breeding.
highlights: Tropical Marker|Deep Blue Zea|Maraschino Pie|Pier Pressure|Suns Out Buns Out|High Tide

name: Jaws Genetics
audit_note: Jaws Genetics is a "breeder's breeder," known for deep-diving into legacy lineages to create stable, heavy-hitting hybrids. Their work with Alien Technology and Aliendog (Chemdawg D x Alien Tech) has redefined the "Exotic" category. Unlike many modern hype breeders, Jaws focuses on hardy, "old-school" structures that thrive both indoors and outdoors. They maintain a presence on Overgrow.com under the handle @JAWS, where they directly interact with the community to share testing results and cultivation advice.
highlights: Alien Cookies F2 #6

name: JBC Seeds
audit_note: JBC Seeds is a "boutique-focused" seed bank that prioritizes quality over quantity. They work with a small, trusted group of geneticists to ensure that every pack they sell represents stable, high-performing genetics. They are a primary node for Bodhi Seeds, often receiving restocks of rare crosses like Banana Yuzu and Strawberry Milk Breath. Locally, they support Vashon Seed and Mercantile, which focuses on heirloom strains and medicinal varieties specifically bred for the Pacific Northwest climate. Their customer service is frequently cited on community platforms like Reddit and THCFarmer for its speed and reliability.
highlights: Archive Seed Bank distributor|Rare elite cuts|Focus on high-quality breeder collaborations

name: Jean-O's Genetics
audit_note: Jean-O's Genetics is a boutique node for high-performance genetics. Jean-O utilizes Colloidal Silver reversal methods to create stable feminized pollen from his most proven winners. His breeding philosophy focuses on "medicinal efficacy," specifically targeting stress, anxiety, and chronic pain. Their flagship Root Beer Float Auto and The Legend S1 are benchmarks for terpene complexity and vigorous growth. He is also a pioneer in the "Fast Version" (FV) space, utilizing Green Poison FV and other elite clones to reduce flowering times without sacrificing potency.
highlights: Root Beer Float Auto|The Legend S1|MJ-12 R2|Honey Badger R2|Brain Drain R2|November Reign R1 Auto

name: Jersey Seedbank
audit_note: Jersey Seed Bank is a key logistical node for the UK market. Being based in the Channel Islands (a self-governing British Crown Dependency), they leverage unique positioning for European distribution. They are a "Mega-Bank" aggregator, stocking major brands like Barney's Farm, Royal Queen Seeds, and Dutch Passion. Technically, they share infrastructure with VaporizerHut Limited, providing a one-stop-shop for both genetics and consumption hardware.
highlights: Localized genetic preservation|Small-batch boutique selections|Regional strain favorites

name: Jimbo Slice Genetics
audit_note: Jimbo Slice Genetics is a niche breeder known for producing "connoisseur-grade" hybrids with extreme aromatic profiles. Their most significant release is the Dirty Glove line, which crosses High 5 (Blue Sherbet x Runtz) with GMO Pie. This technical approach results in plants with exceptional resin coverage and a terpene profile that blends sweet candy notes with heavy, savory funk. They are categorized by the community as a "flavor-first" breeder, often selecting for visual density and wash-ready trichome structures suitable for solventless extraction.
highlights: Dirty Glove (High 5 x GMO Pie)|High 5 (Blue Sherbet x Runtz)|GMO Pie|Jimbo's Kush

name: Jinxproof Genetics
audit_note: Jinxproof Genetics is a pillar of the Pacific Northwest cannabis scene. Their technical focus is on producing vigorous, stable, and highly resinous plants that are "beginner-friendly" yet complex enough for connoisseurs. Their crown jewel, 9lb Hammer, is a cross of Gooberry, Hells OG, and Jack the Ripper, known for its heavy sedative "hammer" effect and fruity terpene profile. Jinxproof is also highly regarded for his "Dank Bank" project, which curates elite genetics that emphasize functional medicine and genetic diversity. His commitment to the community is reflected in his long-standing support for NW Families for Autism.
highlights: 9lb Hammer

name: John Sinclair Seeds
legal_name: John Sinclair Seeds (Collection by Ceres Seeds)
audit_note: John Sinclair Seeds was founded to capture the "essence of a connoisseur's choice" as defined by Sinclair’s 50+ years of activism and taste. The collection was developed in partnership with Ceres Seeds and consists of four to six core stable varieties. These strains are selected for their technical reliability and cultural significance, such as Trans-Love (named after his counter-culture commune) and Viper (a tribute to 1920s jazz culture). Each variety is an F1 hybrid designed to push forward the "march toward worldwide cannabis liberation."
highlights: Trans-Love

name: Joint Custody
audit_note: Joint Custody Seed Co is known for its technical precision in crossing high-potency modern clones with stable heritage favorites. Their most popular release, Cheerios, is a complex cross (Biscotti x Sundae Driver) that has produced several notable descendants. They maintain a Hybrids Map for data verification, allowing growers to track the lineage and stability of their crosses. Their breeding philosophy emphasizes "bag appeal" combined with a heavy, long-lasting medicinal effect, making them a staple for craft medical growers.
highlights: Cheerios

name: Joint Doctor Seeds
audit_note: Doctor's Choice is defined by the legacy of The Joint Doctor, who stabilized the "Mexican Ruderalis" (Mexican Rudy) into the Lowryder line. They specialize in "New-school" and "Old-school" autoflowers that prioritize stability, rapid life cycles, and extreme resilience. Their "Be a Breeder" collection specifically offers regular autoflowering seeds to encourage growers to conduct their own genetic crosses.
highlights: Lowryder|Doctors Choice #1|Cali Crasher|Dc Kush|Devotchka|Rock Machine|Niagara

name: Jolly Pond Farm
audit_note: Jolly Pond Farm is a specialist in "sungrown" genetics, having spent over 6 years breeding specifically for the Northeast outdoor season. Their technical focus is on environmental hardiness and high resin yields. Their strain Wild Blue took 1st place at the 2023 Sungrown Celebration and Competition, noted for its extreme cold resistance (surviving temperatures as low as 19°F). They are recognized for their "washing" strains, which are highly sought after by concentrate lovers for their massive trichome heads and structural integrity during the ice-water extraction process.
highlights: Tropighani

name: Juana's Garden
audit_note: Juana's Garden is a central cultural node in Montpelier, frequently hosting the River Rhythms Summer Concert Series. Their technical focus is on sustainable, Vermont-grown premium cannabis at accessible price points. As a deli-style dispensary, they prioritize education and customer care, providing a high-transparency environment for both medical-intent and recreational users. Their menu is highly dynamic, featuring local craft cultivators like Vermont Select and Sunkissed Farm.
highlights: 10th Planet (Flower)|Blue Dream (Flower)|Seeds (Genetics Section)

name: Jungle Boys
audit_note: Jungle Boys is defined by its "quality over quantity" ethos and 100% transparency through in-house pheno-hunting and tissue culture testing. They are globally recognized for discovering and stabilizing the White Fire OG phenotypes and the world-renowned Mimosa. Their 2026 operations emphasize "Seed-to-Sale" integrity, utilizing their hydrocarbon and solventless labs to produce award-winning live resin and rosin. The brand is a major cultural node for the intersection of cannabis, streetwear (Jungle Boys Clothing), and community collaboration.
highlights: WiFi_43 (White Fire OG pheno)|Mimosa|Zacks Pie|LA Kush Cake|Animal Tsunami|Blu OG (Blu Frootz x 06 OG)|Turbo

Their 2026 operations emphasize "Seed-to-Sale" integrity, utilizing their hydrocarbon and solventless labs to produce award-winning live resin and rosin. The brand is a major cultural node for the intersection of cannabis, streetwear (Jungle Boys Clothing), and community collaboration.

name: Juniper Lane Dispensary
audit_note: Juniper Lane operates with a mission to enrich the local community by providing high-quality cannabis products from local craft growers. They are known for their high-transparency "deli-style" service and a curated menu that highlights Vermont craft brands. Beyond their Bennington hub, they have expanded with a location at 2305 Atlantic Ave, Atlantic City, NJ. Their genetic selection is particularly strong, offering unique local varieties like Pure Vermont 2.0 and Summer Dreams.
highlights: Viperhouse OG Fem Seeds (Anthos)

name: Junk Monkey Genetics
audit_note: A small-scale/boutique breeder known for developing stable hybrid lines (e.g., Galactic 33). Distributed through niche seed banks.

name: Just a Handful Seeds
audit_note: Just a Handful Seeds is characterized by its "anti-corporate" ethos. The breeder, Josh, is known for a polarizing but highly transparent presence on Reddit and Overgrow, where he frequently discusses the economics of breeding and his efforts to keep genetics accessible. Technically, the brand is praised for its "Northern" hardiness—strains like Northern Inferno and Behemoth are bred to handle the shorter, cooler Canadian growing seasons. They are often compared to a "microbrewery" in the seed world, focusing on small-batch artisan crosses rather than mass-market hype.
highlights: Sweet Dragon|Blue Moon|Sweet Blue Sputty|Northern Inferno|Behemoth|Berry

name: Jyllene Genetics
audit_note: Jyllene Genetics is a technical breeder focusing on high-resin photoperiod cultivars. Chuy’s 15+ years in the Emerald Triangle and Northern California scene inform their selection process, prioritizing plant health and metabolic efficiency. Their flagship strain, Fizzberry, is a striking cross of Red Runtz and SinMint Sundae, featuring dense, multi-colored buds and a profile resembling sweet candy. Another significant release, Gasberry Burzt, bridges the gap between sweet pineapple notes and heavy fuel, delivering the "uplifting euphoria" typical of their stabilized hybrids. They are active in the community via the "My Next Harvest" project, which serves as both a genetic showcase and a cultivation resource.
highlights: Fizzberry (Red Runtz x SinMint Sundae)

name: K.C. Brains Genetics
audit_note: K.C. Brains is a master of stabilization. Their flagship strain Mango (K.C. 33 x Afghani) is a multi-Cannabis Cup winner known for producing massive, fruity buds that can reach 3 meters in outdoor environments. Technically, they are praised for their "No-Nonsense" approach—focusing on raw vigor and pest resistance rather than marketing hype. Their Northern Light Special is considered one of the strongest versions of NL ever stabilized, leaning into a heavy indica profile that remains a staple for medical users worldwide. In 2025, they released the Z-710 series, bringing their legacy of stability into the modern "tropical candy" terpene landscape.
highlights: Mango®

name: Kagyu
audit_note: Kagyu is a master preservationist who has spent decades curating a vast collection of heirloom and landrace germplasm. He is credited with helping to stabilize and preserve numerous "classic" lines such as Northern Lights #1 (NL1), M10, and the legendary Big Sur Holy Weed (BSHW). His work often involves making F1 hybrids between these stabilized heirlooms and modern "elite" clone-only strains, such as the Red Head (Headband x Highland Colombian). Kagyu is recognized for his technical discipline, treating cannabis with the same botanical rigor he applied to commercial agriculture, making his seeds a standard for stability and "old school" vigor.
highlights: Big Sur Holy Weed (BSHW)

name: Kalashnikov Seeds
audit_note: Kalashnikov Seeds is a specialist in "harsh climate" genetics. Their technical foundation relies on crossing the Serious Seeds AK-47 with Russian, Eastern European, and Afghan landraces. Their most significant innovation is the Express Line (e.g., Kalashnikov Express), which utilizes "Secret Hybrid" genetics to significantly shorten the flowering cycle (45–55 days) while remaining photo-dependent. This makes them a premier choice for outdoor growers in Northern latitudes like Canada and Northern Europe.
highlights: Kuban Killer (AK-47 x Russian Landrace)

name: Kannabia
audit_note: Kannabia Seeds is a specialist in producing robust, reproducible genetics. Their technical focus is on rigorous quality control and stability testing, ensuring that their cultivars perform as expected for home growers. One of their major technical innovations is the Go Fast line, which utilizes selective breeding to reduce flowering time without losing the control offered by photoperiod plants. Their catalog includes award-winning strains like Mataró Blue, a triple-cross known for its heavy resin production and medical efficacy. They are deeply involved in the community and have official distributors in over 20 countries.
highlights: Mataró Blue|Colombian Jack|Super AK|Swiss Dream CBD

name: Karing Kind
audit_note: Karing Kind is a vertical operation known for its Karing Kind Labs division, which utilizes proprietary CO2 extraction technology to produce pure, additive-free oils. Their technical focus is on maintaining the Clean Green Certification, prioritizing purity and terpene preservation from seed to sale. They are a significant node for 710 Labs products in the region and are highly respected for their "deli-style" transparency and extensive selection of seeds and clones. Their staff is noted for a high degree of technical knowledge, catering to both connoisseurs and medical users.
highlights: Jet Fuel OG (Flower)

name: Karma Genetics
audit_note: Karma Genetics is an elite collective with deep roots in the 90s Dutch scene. Their technical foundation is built on heavy testing and "keeper" hunts. Their flagship Biker Kush (HA-OG x Biker Kush V1) is a cornerstone of their catalog, used to infuse many of their crosses with structural strength and heavy gas. They are equally famous for the Sour Diesel BX series (including Sowahh), which is considered one of the most accurate representations of the original Sour D terpene profile available today. Their strain Headbanger (Sour Diesel x Biker Kush) is a legendary Cannabis Cup winner and is often cited as one of the best high-THC cultivars on the planet.
highlights: Biker Kush|Headbanger|Sowahh|Tha Melon|Karma Sour D BX2|Zowahh

name: Katsu Seeds
audit_note: Katsu Seeds is an "anchor node" for heirloom genetics. Katsu Bluebird is famous for the Katsu Bubba Kush, a pre-98 clone-only variety that he helped popularize globally. Technically, his work focuses on backcrossing and stabilizing these elite legacy clones. His 2026 catalog features the Hotcakes line (a collaboration with Raw Genetics) and the Gas Casket series, which are engineered for high terpene expression and "nostalgic resin" production. He is widely considered a "breeder's breeder," providing the stable foundations many other modern labels use for their own crosses.
highlights: Katsu Bubba Kush

name: Kauai Da Kind Seeds
audit_note: Hawaii-based boutique breeder; focuses on distinct, island-influenced genetic lines. Distributed primarily through niche seed banks.

name: Kavman Kannabliss
audit_note: Kavman Kannabliss is a "breeder's breeder" who focuses on "blast to the past" genetics. His technical specialty is stabilizing 90s era Hawaiian and Skunk lineages. His flagship strain, Funkberry Feedback, is a complex technical cross involving White Widow, '90s Skunk Hawaiian, and '98 Shishkaberry S1, stabilized over three decades for a specific "acrid funk and berry" profile. His seeds are designed for both indoor and outdoor performance, with a heavy emphasis on resilience and balanced mental/physical effects.
highlights: Funkberry Feedback|Coughing Comet|Stellar Stank|Shishkaberry S1 Hybrids

name: Kaya Spain Quality
audit_note:
Kaya Spain Quality is a technical powerhouse in the South American market. Their breeding team utilizes high-altitude expeditions to source genetics that possess natural resilience to environmental stress. Their flagship strain, Super THC, is a stabilized cross of Black Domina and Afghan Kush, engineered specifically for extreme resin production and pharmaceutical-grade extractions. Another key variety, Big Brother (White Widow x Black Domina), is praised for its "unshakeable" structural stability during late-stage flowering. All KSQ seeds are subjected to multiclimate testing to guarantee viability in both Mediterranean and temperate zones.

Kaya Spain Quality (KSQ) operates primarily through trusted international seed distributors rather than a single direct proprietary website
highlights: Super THC|Big Brother|Tropical Power|Sirocco Tiara

name: Keefy Canopy
audit_note: Keefy Canopy is a foundational pillar of the Illinois craft cannabis scene. They are the creators of Keefy Cannafest, an annual massive event in Peoria featuring live music, 50+ vendors, and "Dab Bars" sponsored by Dr. Dabber. Technically, they act as a verified vendor for elite labels like NightOwl Seeds, often providing exclusive "schwag" and bonus packs with purchases. Their mission focuses on the "Seed to Session" journey, emphasizing education and direct breeder-to-grower connections. They are highly active on Instagram and Reddit, where they maintain a reputation for excellent customer satisfaction and community engagement.
highlights: Focus: High-terpene artisan cultivars|Focused on flavor-first breeding

name: Keepers of The Flame
audit_note: Keepers of the Flame is highly regarded for their technical approach to "back-to-basics" breeding. They are famous for the Vigilante series and The Kragle, a complex poly-hybrid involving GG4 and TGA genetics. Their autoflower work, often released under or in collaboration with the SOFEM label, includes technical favorites like Blood Lemon Russian and Cherry Cheese Skunk. Their breeding philosophy emphasizes structural integrity and "wash-ready" trichome production, making them popular among home growers who perform solventless extractions.
highlights: Vigilante F2

name: Kendogsmoke Seeds
audit_note: Kendogsmoke Seeds is characterized by its technical expertise in cross-breeding elite modern clones with stable heirloom varieties. Their flagship lineage, Primal Scream, is a complex hybrid involving Blue Dream [Bx] and JSD Sugar Drum, which has served as the foundation for many of their later releases. Technically, the brand is praised for its "easy, fast-growing" traits; for example, the Titanic Apple Primal Scream is noted for its sweet bubblegum aroma and "mind-numbing" slow-motion high. Their JSD Sugar Drum variety is frequently cited for its heavy yields and "sweet candy" terpene profile with distinct pink and purple highlights.
highlights: Titanic Apple Primal Scream

name: Kera Seeds
audit_note: Kera Seeds is a highly technical operation that subjects every strain to rigorous multi-generational testing for "vigour and yield" before public release. They are particularly famous for their Amnesia Mac Ganja (AMG Haze), a multi-award-winning Sativa (Amnesia x Mexican Haze) created by the legendary breeder "The Ganja Man." Their technical focus also extends to the Kera California line, which acclimates elite West Coast clones like Gelato and Gorilla Glue for European growing conditions. In 2026, they remain a top-tier choice for budget-conscious home growers who require "bulletproof" stability and manual seed selection by size and weight.
highlights: Amnesia Mac Ganja (AMG Haze)

name: Kevin Jodrey
audit_note: Kevin Jodrey is a master of "calculated risk" in genetics. After serving as a US Coast Guard diver (interdicting drug traffickers), he transitioned into full-time cultivation and founded Wonderland Nursery in 2013. He is technically famous for his work with Phylos Bioscience to genotype his entire library, ensuring genetic transparency for customers like B-Real of Cypress Hill. His breeding focuses on structural integrity and "washability" for hash production. He is a co-founder of Humboldt Seed Co., alongside Nathaniel Pennington, which remains a cornerstone of your database.
highlights: Tire Fire OG|Black Veil (Black Domina x White Widow)|Hemlock (Durban Poison x LA Confidential)

name: Khalifa Genetics
audit_note: Khalifa Genetics is a technical leader in "Ancestral Breeding." Their catalog is split between the Landrace Collection (e.g., Sheberghan Hash Plant, 80's Durban Poison) and the Hybrid Collection, which features "True F1s" like Aladdin Kush. Unlike unstable polyhybrids, their F1s are crosses between carefully selected and stabilized landrace or rare lines. They are also famous for the "Freak" series, such as Frosty’s Purple Freak, which features mutated leaf morphology for stealth growing. All seed production is 100% organic, and they refresh their stock annually to ensure maximum viability.
highlights: Aladdin Kush|Frosty's Purple Freak|Balkh Hash Plant|Afghan Lemon|Deep Chunk

name: Kief Sweat
audit_note: Kief Sweat was a master of resin-heavy OG hybrids. He is technically famous for his work with the Ewe-2 cut (an elite California Indica) and his "Glazed" series, which emphasizes heavy resin, bud density, and complex "gas-meets-dessert" terpene profiles. His preferred breeding and growing method involved rockwool/coco hydroponics with meticulous hand-watering to maintain a "direct relationship" with every plant. His genetics are highly sought after by connoisseurs and hash-makers due to their exceptional trichome structure and high THC potential.
highlights: Glazed Punch (Glazed Black Cherries x Purple Punch)

name: Killerz Genetics
audit_note: Killerz Genetics is a technical leader in the "modern dessert" category. Their breeding philosophy centers on Pure Biscotti crosses, engineered for high bag appeal, compact growth structures, and extreme resin coverage. Their flagship variety, Beam Me Up Scottie (Pure Biscotti x Scotty 2 Hotti), is a case study in "sweet cream and gas" stabilization. Other technical standouts include Going Biscotti, which doubles down on the cookie dough profile, and Blackout Zkittles, which introduces candy-fruit mutations into the heavy cookie base. Their seeds are a staple for growers targeting the "loud and dense" aesthetic typical of top-shelf California-style flower.
highlights: Beam Me Up Scottie (Regular)

name: Kind Castle
audit_note: Kind Castle is famous for its unique retail design, having won "Best Dispensary Design in the USA" by Leafbuyer. They emphasize organic cultivation standards, sourcing products from small-batch growers across Colorado who use only organic fertilizers. Their Commerce City superstore is a verified high-authority node for top-tier brands including Green Dot Labs, 710 Labs, and Summit Cannabis. They are widely recognized for their aggressive pricing—often offering ounces starting at $49 out-the-door—making them a primary destination for both connoisseurs and budget-conscious shoppers.
highlights: Green Dot Labs (Full Line)|In The Flow (Flower)|Shift Cannabis|710 Labs (Concentrates)|Artsy Cannabis|Kind Castle Organic Flower

name: Kindway Farms
audit_note: Kindway Farms operates as a technical breeding node with a focus on Farm Bill compliant hemp-derived seeds (<0.3% THC). They are the organizers of the Common Ground Fair and maintain a "Cropoholics Anonymous" social club. Technically, their work involves stabilizing diverse crosses like Galaxy 500 and Lucky Charmalade, utilizing parents like Boss Hog, Black Garlic, and Chemdog D. Their flagship variety, Cujo, is noted for its medium-high yield and 9-week flowering time. They prioritize education and local community engagement, serving as a primary genetic resource for the Midwest.
highlights: Lucky Charmalade|Cujo|Galaxy 500|Sunny Z

name: Kinetic Genetics
audit_note: Kinetic Genetics is characterized by its mastery of the "Grape" and "Gas" terpene intersection. Their technical specialty is improving the yield and vigor of legendary but finicky clones. For example, their The Soap x Grape Pie Mints cross is engineered for "monstrous" production, blending the heavy kush aroma of Seed Junky’s Kushmints with distinct grape and lavender soap profiles. Another technical standout, Purple Urkle x (Sour Grapes x Floji), is noted for its "grapes on grapes" flavor profile and deep burgundy-wine coloration that surfaces late in the flowering cycle. Their seeds are specifically optimized for both indoor and outdoor cultivation in temperate climates.
highlights: The Soap x Grape Pie Mints

name: Kingdom Organics Seeds
audit_note: Kingdom Organic Seeds is anchored by The Rev, a breeder with over 35 years of experience. KOS is unique for its rejection of feminized or reversed seeds, producing only regular stock to maintain sexual health and genetic vigor. Their breeding is done exclusively using True Living Organic (TLO) methods—breeding in soil so healthy that living worms are often still in the root balls at harvest. They specialize in high-type "connoisseur" Sativas, including rare Thai and Haze crosses that are often stabilized from "yesteryear" vault genetics. Their 2026 catalog includes technical favorites like Candyman Haze and Malawi Moonshine, which are engineered for long-duration, high-potency effects.
